status: Engineering reference (G14-RG, owner approval 23/11/2026 « tek kapı / guichet unique »). Each situation only POINTS to ids that already carry their official source and date: the needs and fiches of the public Rights Graph view (data/reference/rights-public-view.v1.json, DILA archive read 2026-11-18), the reviewed Mon Parcours step types (data/reference/parcours-step-types.v1.json, DILA archive read 2026-11-22), the structure types of the catalogue (data/reference/social-domains.v1.json, data/reference/guide-offices.v1.json) and the emergency numbers of the catalogue (cited by fiche F33954). No right, amount, condition or deadline is written here: an id that does not resolve to a sourced record is not shown (tests/unit/g14-rg-situation.test.jsx).
readMe: needs: ids of data/reference/rights-public-view.v1.json needs (= catalogue subdomain ids) — bodies, « Où s'adresser », link to /droits/<need>.
subdomains: « domain/subdomain » ids of data/reference/social-domains.v1.json (20 domains × 86 subdomains).
rights: Service-Public fiche ids of an aide or prestation, resolved in the public view (dates) or in the Mon Parcours sources (dates); shown as « vous pouvez vérifier si… », never as an entitlement.

steps: { stepType } = a code of the closed Mon Parcours list (its label and sources come from that list; « Ajouter à Mon Parcours » is offered only for these), or { fiche } = an official fiche that describes what to do.
structures: type_structure values of the directory (the /structures?type= filter, an exact match).
emergency: numbers of social-domains.v1.json « emergency »; danger = the emergency block is shown first.
keywords: deterministic synonyms per interface language, matched IN THE BROWSER only (src/lib/lifeSituations.js); the typed text is never sent, stored or logged.
family: the group of the /situation index (FAMILIES order). Labels of situations and families: src/lib/situationLabels.js, generated with this file by scripts/life-situations-build.py.

Fiches are resolved in four sourced tiers: the public Rights Graph view, the Mon Parcours list sources, the live check of « liveChecks » (page read on service-public.gouv.fr: title, « Vérifié le » date, read date), then the Rights Graph source ledger (data/rules/rights-graph-sources.v1.json, DILA archive read 2026-11-18; fiche titles and dates only — no D11 rule or condition).

liveChecks.method: page lue sur service-public.gouv.fr (HTTP 200, sans redirection) ; titre = intitulé de la page, verifiedAt = sa date « Vérifié le »
